semantics.risk_sum: validated risk atoms are summed once across disjoint equipment campaigns
semantics.missing_scope: missing or incomplete equipment/families remain partial and never become zero risk
semantics.frequency: each atom retains its initiating event frequency; no frequency inference or reallocation is performed
semantics.frequency_port_binding: reviewed event port_ids are carried into cases and risk_atoms and checked again at facility merge; missing or mismatched port rows withhold the facility scope
semantics.provider_packet: qualified provider packet evidence is counted separately from the numerical risk sum; a provider release history never creates or changes an initiating frequency
semantics.fn: expected-death F-N curves use the same atom-level convention as the campaign backend
semantics.conditional_diagnostic_facility: facility IR/F-N is calculated from the atoms that reached the risk ledger, but remains diagnostic-only whenever declared scope, physical validation, or release-horizon blockers are present
semantics.timing: whole-case and per-stage elapsed milliseconds are observed execution evidence; they are not repeated-run latency, throughput, or a fresh-physics 1 Hz claim
semantics.component_coverage: each case is assigned to its provider component when available, then to its event component; conditional case identities are deduplicated, while strict uncomputed counts retain raw evidence rows and never create a frequency
semantics.scenario_family_contributions: risk atoms retain their declared scenario_families; overlapping physical families are views of the same atoms and must not be summed across families
semantics.component_risk_ranking: equipment rows are ranked by peak receptor IR from the same conditional risk atoms; this is a diagnostic triage view and never reallocates frequency or promotes facility IR/F-N
semantics.scenario_branch_accounting: annual-condition weather, release/termination, and ignition branches are preserved as diagnostics over the same risk atoms; no branch frequency is inferred, reallocated, or double-counted
semantics.release_termination_inventory: case-level provider duration, termination, isolation, inventory and mass closure are retained in one facility ledger; withheld copies remain in the summary and are never converted to zero risk
semantics.case_risk_atom_trace: each risk atom carries the matched case identity and status; non-EXECUTED or unmatched cases stay in the conditional diagnostic view but cannot open strict facility-QRA promotion

frequency_uncertainty.semantics: published marginal event-frequency quantiles plus explicit fixed catalogue rates, with within-asset shared or independent-event bound comparison; fixed physical harm/weather/barrier/population/ignition; incomplete scope remains incomplete

semantics.orchestration: campaign results are merged once; no source or consequence model is rerun
semantics.partial_scope: missing equipment, accident families, or event case accounting remains explicit and withholds facility totals
semantics.conditional_diagnostic_facility: the atom-level facility IR/F-N sum is exposed for diagnostics and frequency sensitivity, while qualification blockers continue to withhold the facility total
semantics.frequency: optional literature scenarios reweight saved risk atoms and do not infer missing frequency
semantics.frequency_port_binding: the reviewed accident port is exposed at the assessment boundary and is checked through events, cases, risk atoms and the merged facility ledger; legacy rows remain unaudited rather than receiving an inferred port
semantics.provider_packet: qualified provider packet evidence is counted separately from the numerical risk sum; a provider release history never creates or changes an initiating frequency
semantics.facility_case_packet_coverage: exact facility case identity must be qualified before the facility QRA gate can open; missing cases remain explicit and do not infer frequency or physical validation
semantics.scenario_branch_accounting: annual-condition weather, release/termination, and ignition branches are preserved over the same validated atoms; no frequency inference or branch reallocation is performed
semantics.release_termination_inventory: case-level provider duration, termination, isolation, inventory and mass closure are carried through the merged facility ledger without filling missing branch values
semantics.timing: facility timing preserves observed whole-case and stage elapsed values; it does not claim repeated-run throughput or fresh-physics 1 Hz service
